registration.budget_scope: row_budget and seconds_budget apply per policy-run stage invocation (one TimedBudget per stage in run_ml_policy.policy_run); sized as 2x the largest extrapolated stage (blend-control)
registration.tau_selection: June blend-control: largest original unpenalized mean defensive WE; exact ties prefer larger tau
registration.primary_family: DEV control world: P1-P0, P2-P1, P3-P2; Holm alpha .05
registration.inference_minimum: 30 distinct games and 50 supported PA starts, else all three Holm slots null
registration.preliminary_screen: mean imputed dWE >= 0.0001 (0.01 percentage points) per PA, game-bootstrap lower bound > 0, Holm <= .05
registration.strong_model_internal: additionally worst-case mean > 0, both CI lower bounds > 0, Holm over max(imputed_p, worst_case_p) <= .05
registration.candidate_world: sensitivity only; not a second success family
